description: Every commit needs a DCO sign-off (scripts/check-dco.sh), Renovate's included.

packageRules.description: pnpm refuses packages under a day old (its minimumReleaseAge), so Renovate waits as long: otherwise its PRs fail to install.

Third-party actions run with the release jobs' token and deploy key, so they're pinned to a commit (a tag can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags. DECISIONS #326.
